name: Michigan Mini FMC 2023
information:
THIS COMPETITION TAKES PLACE ON FRIDAY NIGHT!

Due to the nature of Fewest Moves, we hope to allow people to joing attempt #1 slightly late, but cannot promise this. We recommend doing your best to arrive on time for the first attempt. 
Please let us know if you will be arriving after 6pm so that we can plan accordingly. 

Free parking is available on site
